story: Parvati made Ganesha to guard her door. When he blocked Shiva, Shiva cut off his head, then restored him with an elephant's head and made him the first god to be worshipped before any other. In a race around the world with his brother, Ganesha simply walked around his parents, saying they were his whole world, and won.
belief: Ganesha is prayed to first before any new start, from weddings to exams, because he removes obstacles. He is the god of wisdom, beginnings and good luck.
turns: When he fell off his mouse with a full belly, the moon laughed at him, and Ganesha cursed it. That is why it is said to be unlucky to look at the moon on Ganesh Chaturthi.
facts: Tradition says he wrote down the Mahabharata as Vyasa dictated it, using his broken tusk as a pen.
Ganesh Chaturthi became a huge public festival after Lokmanya Tilak promoted it in the 1890s.
His favourite sweet is the modak.
